notes.title: SOTG to the Paris Fan Festival
notes.content:
Guild Studio, will be present at the Paris Fan Festival which will be held from April 15 to 16, at the Paris Porte de Versailles exhibition center. The studio will present "Shadow of the Guild", its action-platformer inspired by Prince of Persia and the books "La Guilde des Marchands de Pluie".

In addition to presenting "Shadow of the Guild", Guild Studio also announced a surprise for video game fans. Although the studio has remained tight-lipped on the details, it is sure that visitors will be able to enjoy a unique and exciting gaming experience.

“We are delighted to participate in the Paris Fan Festival this year and present our latest game, Shadow of the Guild, to video game fans,” said the CEO of Guild Studio. "We're also looking forward to sharing our surprise with players, so be sure to drop by the Guild Studio booth to find out more."

Visitors to the Paris Fan Festival will be able to meet the developers of Guild Studio and ask questions about the development of "Shadow of the Guild". The show is also a unique opportunity to discover the latest trends in the world of video games and to meet other enthusiasts.

If you are a fan of video games, be sure not to miss the Paris Fan Festival event this year and visit the Guild Studio booth to discover our latest game and maybe more ;)

notes.title: Experience the Next Chapter in the Epic Shadow of the Guild
notes.content:
The first major update for Shadow of the Guild includes a number of improvements and enhancements to the game. Some of the key updates are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285225/f8b75f0991542c4eae0fbc26e166781aea6f19cb.gif[/img]

[b]Enhanced animations in the rolling motion:[/b] We have improved the animations for the rolling motion, making it look more smooth and realistic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285225/88c580d93417101ba97beb5ada68e88c7a0206e8.gif[/img]

[b]Brand new speedrun mode:[/b] We have added a new speedrun mode to the game, allowing players to compete against each other to see who can complete the game in the fastest time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285225/aa1fb9dba0e2c252d91ba7a9c1bfd57943916836.png[/img]

[b]Larger hitboxes:[/b] We have increased the size of the hitboxes in the game, making it easier to hit enemies and avoid attacks.

[b]Other cool improvements in gameplay:[/b] In addition to the above changes, we have made a number of other improvements to the gameplay, including tweaks to the balance and overall polish of the game.

We hope these changes will provide a better and more enjoyable experience for players of Shadow of the Guild.

notes.title: Shadow of the Guild V1.0 Out now in full launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285225/40fcf802b9c659dc3e31f8c4ea7ec63fe624c66c.png[/img]

Ahoy, sailors of the skies! Welcome aboard the ships of Rain Merchants’ Guild. We’re happy to announce that Shadow of the Guild is out now with version 1.0!

See our latest and greatest trailer here:

[previewyoutube=DIq06ebAijE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are extremely excited to see how you will fulfil your mission to destroy the Emperor Gethro III’s evil sky pirates and make their resistance futile.

Let’s have a small read on the main features and gameplay of Shadow of the Guild’s release.

[h2]The game in a nutshell
[/h2][list]
[*] Beat ‘em up with RPG elements: choose your style from the skills of mages, assassins, and warriors
[*] Over 5 hours of gameplay and an epic & quirky story
[*] Created by a French solo developer and author of the books of the same series: Robin Buisson
[/list]

[Cinematics gif]

[h2]Main features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fight the enemies using magic, stealthy assassinations, and beat ‘em up with straight-up sword combos
[*] Beautiful cinematics and well crafted dialogues moving you forward in the story; localised in French, Portuguese, and Romanian in addition to English
[*] Use environment to your advantage by hiding in the shadows and throwing weapons at enemies
[/list]

Here we go! Go forth now and save the world from the evil emperor.

Please report any issues you might experience [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1767250/discussions/]here on our Steam Community forum[/url].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767250/Shadow_of_the_Guild/#app_reviews_hash][h3]And please do remember to leave a Steam review! Or unless you want Yaran to come and find you…[/h3][/url]

notes.title: Release date confirmed
notes.content:
[h2]Shadow of the Guild is nearly here: just under one month of a wait left for the release![/h2] 

Steam Next Fest brought the game attention well deserved with thousands of viewers on streams.

[i]“Luckily I didn’t see the number of viewers… I thought I was alone so I just kept having fun on the stream lol!”[/i] 

said the developer of Shadow of the Guild, Robin Buisson from the Guild Studios after his nearly three hours broadcast during Steam’s October 2022 Next Fest. Over a hundred thousand unique viewers and nearly ten thousand concurrent viewers brought Shadow of the Guild some well-deserved demo-enthusiast attention.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285225/aeb48f94c87765bea4dae1ebc162e62359417820.gif[/img]


Guild Studios has been making the beat ‘em up / RPG / story-driven Metroidvania for a long time since it originally started as a saga of books, penned by the lead developer of the game! The French book series called The Rain Merchant’s Guild tells the story of the said guild, which controls the clouds, rain, and thus the water available to the people.

[h3]Story
[/h3]
Shadow of the Guild sets up a premise for the books and lets you play as one of the Guild’s Shadows, Yarán. A shadow is part of the Guild’s spies who are trained to be warriors, mages, and assassins. Yarán receives a mission to solve how the evil Emperor Gethro III has learned to make clouds himself and is trying to steal the domination of rain and clouds from the Guild.

[h3]Gameplay
[/h3]
Shadow of the Guild is a side-scrolling beat ‘em up with an RPG-like progression. When you go further in your mission you will be able to choose which skills you want to develop. You can choose from the paths of warrior, mage, or assassin, each focusing on different skill trees. 

The actual gameplay lasts for about 5 to 7 hours depending on how deep you want to dive into the story. And why wouldn’t you, it truly is a magnificent story.

The Guild Studio is also promising a lot of upcoming updates on their roadmap, including speedrunner features on their first update following the release, more content, and missions, and they’re hinting something about slaying a horde of pirates…

Shadow of the Guild is arriving on Steam on November 10th, so stay tuned by [b]wishlisting[/b] and following on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767250/Shadow_of_the_Guild/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767250/Shadow_of_the_Guild/[/url]

For press and influencers, review codes are now available, and preview opportunities are open for inquiries to chosen ones. Contact team@bonusstage.co.

notes.title: Shadow of the Guild - Open Beta in Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Greeting, Warriors!
[/h1]

We're pleased to announce that our first public beta test is now live. You'll be able to experience about one hour of the gameplay we have so far.

This playtest will run from now until end of September.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285225/aeb48f94c87765bea4dae1ebc162e62359417820.gif[/img]

[h2]What to Expect
[/h2]

Although Shadow Of The Guild is coming along nicely, it's not complete yet. Most of the gameplay features are in place and working, but we still have a lot of content to add.

All that said, we feel like we have a decent early game experience here, and we hope this playtest will offer you quite a few hours of entertainment.

[h2]Feedback
[/h2]

For this test, we are looking for your gameplay feedback. How the game feels, what are your thoughts, did you enjoy playing, did you hate something?

Please join our [url=http://discord.bonusstage.co]Discord[/url] to give feedback and your five cents after you've played the game. Your feedback helps us understand how players experience Shadow Of The Guild, and will let us identify areas that still need improvement.

In our [url=http://discord.bonusstage.co]Discord[/url], you can leave bug reports, ask for or discuss features, or just hang out with our community. [url=http://discord.bonusstage.co]http://discord.bonusstage.co[/url]

notes.title: Shadow of the Guild will be published by Bonus Stage Publishing in 2022
notes.content:
[i]Choose your style from the skill trees of assassins, mages, or warriors and live up to your honour in Shadow of the Guild, published by Bonus Stage Publishing on PC in 2022. Shadow of the Guild is a beat-em-up platformer made by a French company Guild Studio, and its story has its roots in bestselling books authored by the studio’s founder and main developer.
[/i]
Bonus Stage Publishing is extremely happy to announce the publishing of the Shadow of the Guild, coming out in 2022 on PC. Shadow of the Guild is inspired by Prince of Persia and it has a RPG style progression for your character. You play as a warrior of Rain Merchant’s Guild, whose mission to provide water all over the world is under the threat of Gethro III’s Eastern Empire, and you must now investigate what Gethro is doing and get your organisation's powers back.

You can choose to infiltrate the Empire by lurking in the shadows as a sneaky assassin, beat ‘em all up as a fierce warrior, or cast all-powerful spells upon the enemies. Once you choose your path, you can upgrade your specific skills on your character or develop all skills to be a balanced spy. Complete side quests, find attack combos, unlock the epic cutscenes revealing the story, and enhance your character with various consumables giving you new powers. 

Shadow of the Guild will come out on PC in 2022, and it will have a playtime of roughly 6 hours. Follow the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767250/Shadow_of_the_Guild/]here on Steam[/url] and on the publisher’s [url=https://bonusstage.co/]website here[/url].

[previewyoutube=PYCK5ZAZEEU;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dCteeWhY4eLq62GC7GjHeJMyVqx1tGSb?usp=sharing]See the press kit here[/url]

About the developer:
Guild Studio is a French video game studio. It aims to create wonderful worlds in which it invites players. Founded by writer Robin Buisson and graphic designer Arnaud Wallet, Guild Studio launches its first title "Shadow of the Guild", a 2D action/platformer inspired by one of its founders' favourite games, "Prince of Persia".

About the publisher:
Bonus Stage Publishing is an indie game publisher with a Finnish spirit: no bs, just good publishing. The company was founded to bring some honesty and friendliness to the indie publishing world. Their released titles include Sunblaze, Warshmallows, and JANITOR BLEEDS.
